name: 蔡子萱
objective:
本課程介紹粒子物理作用與化學現象間的關係，並討論相平衡、化學平衡、氫原子模型、反應速率等的觀念，主要教學內容包括氣體行為、基礎熱力學、基礎量子力學、化學動力學及電化學等重要理論。
This course explores the relationship between particle physics interactions and chemical phenomena, covering key concepts such as phase equilibrium, chemical equilibrium, the hydrogen atom model, and reaction rates. The main instructional content includes important theories such as gas behavior, fundamental thermodynamics, basic quantum mechanics, chemical kinetics, and electrochemistry.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 01-02	Chemical Kinetics
Week 03-04	Gas & Equations of State
Week 05-06	The Laws of Thermodynamics
Week 07-08	Gibbs Energy and Chemical Potential
Week 09-10	EXAM & Phase Equilibrium
Week 11-12	Chemical Equilibrium 
Week 13-14	Electrochemical Equilibrium 
Week 15-16	Quantum Mechanics & EXAM
